title: Evaluation Domain
description: Represents a skos:Collection grouping the 3SE analyses in scope of one of the 10 engineering domains evaluated by the 3SE maturity evaluation method.

@context.description: JSON-LD context URI. Must reference the canonical context document for this schema.

@id.description: The globally unique IRI identifying this domain as an RDF resource. Must be an absolute URI under the domains/ base IRI.

@type.description: RDF type declaration. Domains are modelled as skos:Collection — a labelled, unordered grouping of concepts, not a hierarchical skos:ConceptScheme.

title.description: skos:prefLabel — The preferred human-readable label for this domain (e.g. 'Risk management').

description.description: skos:definition — A complete explanation of the scope of this evaluation domain.

notes.description: skos:scopeNote — A note clarifying the intended use or boundaries of this domain. Markdown is supported.

members.description: skos:member — IRIs of the 3se-onto analysis concepts (terms/*-analysis-3se-*) that this domain is accountable for. The concrete concepts to rate for this domain's process/method/tool axes are retrieved by following each member analysis's own 'related' relation. Omitted when no accountable analysis concept exists yet in 3se-onto — CI should warn (not fail) on an empty or missing members list.

deprecated.description: owl:deprecated — When true, signals that this domain is obsolete and should no longer be used in new data.

superseded_by.description: dcterms:isReplacedBy — IRI of the domain that supersedes this one when deprecated is true.

entryCreated.description: dcterms:created — ISO 8601 date on which this domain entry was first created.

entryModified.description: dcterms:modified — ISO 8601 date on which this domain entry was last modified.

entryCreator.description: dcterms:creator — The agent(s) who originally created this domain entry.

entryContributor.description: dcterms:contributor — Agent(s) who contributed to this domain entry after its initial creation.

status.description: 3SE editorial status of this domain entry.

agent.description: A foaf:Agent — a person, organisation, or software agent.

@id.description: IRI of the agent (e.g. ORCID, WebID, GitHub profile URL). Maps to foaf:Agent @id.

name.description: foaf:name — Full name or display name of the agent.

mbox.description: foaf:mbox — Email address of the agent.
